training: StatsBomb open data (non-penalty shots with freeze frames): UEFA Euro 2020, Euro 2024, AFCON 2023, Bundesliga 2023/24, Ligue 1 2022/23, MLS 2023 (open matches), Premier League 2015/16 (first 200 matches) - 10708 shots, 996 goals. World Cup 2022 NOT used for training.
units: metres, goal centre at (0,0); n_block = outfield opponents inside the triangle ball-post-post; gk_dist = keeper to goal-line centre; gk_off_line = keeper distance from the line ball->goal centre; n_close = opponents within 3 m of the shooter

validation.test: StatsBomb open data, FIFA World Cup 2022 (64 matches, held out)
